# Super-Claude for SAP (SC4SAP)

> An AI workspace that connects directly to your SAP system and reads its code, configuration, and business flows, from code analysis through to documents and program generation. It comes as an open-source Claude Code plugin and as a web workspace. The web workspace opens for a closed test on 2026-11-11.

The site is in Korean.

## Key facts

- Platforms: ECC 6.0, S/4HANA On-Premise, S/4HANA Cloud (Public and Private), with ADT enabled
- AI: Anthropic Claude (Claude Code)
- Integrations: VS Code, Obsidian, Notion
- The plugin and the web workspace share the same skills
- Two run modes: standard, and eco for lower cost with the same deliverable

## Skills

Ask a module consultant, code analysis, symptom analysis, CBO inventory, program comparison, program to spec, program to manual, module to process, configuration to document, interface mapping spec, program creation, object creation, SmartForm from PDF, SmartForm preview, project dashboard, role matrix, and SAP doctor.
